items: 【Apple Home Support】ULTRALOQ’s first fingerprint smart deadbolt is fully integrated with Apple Home. Unlock your door using your iPhone or Apple Watch, share access with family and guests. Add a HomePod or Apple TV as a home hub to enable automations, remote access and control your lock remotely with Siri—making your home smarter, safer, and more connected.

items.label: 【Control from Anywhere】
items.value: Lock, unlock, grant permanent, scheduled, or temporary access to family, guests, and service people. Store up to 50 fingerprints and passcodes, view lock activity, and get real-time alerts in the U-Home App. Perfect for homeowners or hosts. NOTE: 2.4g wifi required. No extra hubs needed.

items.label: 【The Most Versatile Keyless Entry Door Lock】
items.value: Fingerprint ID + Passcodes + App Remote Unlocking + Auto Unlock + Voice Control with Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant + Web portal + 2 Backup Keys

items.label: 【Smart Home Ready】
items.value: bolt fingerprint smart lock is works seamlessly with Alexa, Apple Home, Google Home, Smartthings, IFTTT and thee U-home app, Control your door hands-free with Siri, Alexa and Google Voice Assistant.

items.label: 【Smart Auto Lock and Auto Unlock】
items.value: ULTRALOQ smart wifi deadbolt automatically locks when the door closes and unlocks as you arrive with your smartphone. Get instant app alerts if your door is left open. Never worry about forgetting to lock your door again.

items.label: 【Built Strong. Built to Last】
items.value: 8 AA batteries power the smart lock for up to 1 year through regular use. Crafted with a high-strength zinc alloy body and certified with the ANSI/BHMA highest residential rating for security, durability, and finish. IP65 dustproof and weather-resistant, built to withstand heat and cold.

items.label: 【Easy DIY Installation & Reliable Support】
items.value: Replace your current deadbolt in just 10 minutes with a screwdriver, no drilling, no professional needed. Enjoy lifetime mechanical coverage, 18 months of electronic protection, lifetime phone support (Mon–Fri, 7 AM–6 PM PST), and 24/7 after-sales email service.

items.label: Included Components
